Allahabad University Ph.D Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : University of Allahabad has released a Notification for the Allahabad University Ph.D Courses Admission 2026. Applications for the Allahabad University Ph.D Online Form 2026 will Start From 02 September 2026, & candidate can apply until 25 September 2026. Candidates must check the Complete details for Allahabad University Ph.D Online Form 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 25 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 300/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
